title: Fractal Airbending
description: Adds Airbending to the game, Airbending SLICE!
body:
Master the art of air bending with nine unique abilities designed for mobility, crowd control, and utility.  

10+  
Abilities Like:  

Air Blast — Select an air source and launch enemies away, or launch yourself by targeting the ground beneath you  
Air Scooter — High-speed ground travel on a ball of air  
Offload — Discharge accumulated air pressure  
Swipe — Projectile air slash that damages enemies in front of you  
Air Burst — Suffocate and launch nearby enemies  
Vortex — Levitate above the ground in a cyclone, scaling higher with your range stat. Pushes nearby entities upward  
Meditation — Hold shift to meditate and regenerate a burst of chi after a short channel. After meditating, you can astral project.  
Air Glide — Sustained flight while holding shift, requiring air blocks nearby to start  
Air Spout  

/b choose  

Requires Fractal Bending Core.
